segment.source: Renders the whole team as an even grid of portraits, each with a name, a role and an optional link to a profile. Use it for: the main block of an about page, a department page after a short intro, a studio showing everyone at equal size. Prefer 'Leadership Row' when a handful of people should be shown larger than the rest, and 'Team Directory' when the team has outgrown portraits and needs readable rows instead.
